ex.note: Start with 3 warmup sets of 3-5 reps. Pick a weight to attempt a 3-6 Rep Max attempt.
Using the same weight as the 3-6RM, perform the same number of sets of singles. Ex: 4RM = 4 sets of 1. If RPE of last set is 7 or less, add up to an additional 3 sets.
